title: GREEN TOMATO SOUP
instructions: --Chop fine five green tomatoes and boil twenty minutes in water to cover. Then add one quart hot milk, to which a teaspoonful soda has been added, let come to a boil, take from the fire and add a quarter cupful butter  rubber into four crackers rolled fine, with salt and pepper to taste.
